description.sub_name: 音樂行旅 - 巡訪古典音樂大師
description.sub_ename: A MUSICAL JOURNEY WITH THE GREAT COMPOSERS
description.describe_ch: 本課程帶領學生們認識德奧及中歐等國各個音樂重鎮所蘊育的偉大古典音樂作曲家，跟隨大師們的足跡，了解作曲家在各個時期、不同城市發展的小故事。透過巡訪作曲家的故居博物館並觀賞其珍藏，引領學生們進入時空隧道，了解大師們經典作品的背景故事，更能進一步體會並感受音樂之美。
description.describe_eh: The course introduces the lives and works of the great classical music composers. Following the paths and cities where their careers based, students are able to gain a deeper understanding of the historical and cultural backgrounds of the time, which had an impact on their musical output, thus cultivate a greater appreciation of these music compositions. This course aims at helping students to make connections between knowledge and real-life aesthetic experiences, thus developing a capability to further explore classical music and to motivate independent learning and research in the future.

targets.describe_ch: 了解古典音樂的歷史脈絡並培養對音樂藝術的鑑賞與想像力

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Please follow the proper school procedures in advance if you need to miss a class.

◆ You are required to take notes during weekly lectures.
◆ Written notes will be collected during a randomly selected week for grading.
◆ Loose-leaf paper or a binder is recommended.

Each group will present a selected repertoire from a specific stylistic period. The presentation should include a brief biography of the composer, the historical and cultural background, the inspiration for the composition, and the musical features of the work, along with personal reflections on the piece.

Twice a Semester.
Students will identify stylistic periods, composers, and genres of selected compositions.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Attendance 出席狀況  (15% )

2. Written notes 課堂筆記 (10%)

3. Listening Quiz I &II 聽聽看小考兩次 (期中10% + 期末10% = 20%)
Identify stylistic periods, composers, and genres of selected compositions. 
以分組報告之曲目以及課堂中聽過的曲目為範圍，鑑賞和辨別作曲家、樂派及風格。 

4. Group Repertoire Presentation 分組報 (30%):
每組以老師指定的曲目範圍內，搜集資料、研究整理，並以口頭報告和Power Point的呈現方式介紹給班上同學。
Each group will present a selected repertoire from one of the great composers. The presentation should cover a short biography of the composer, the background, inspiration, and musical features of the composition, along with personal thoughts on the musical work itself.

5.Concert Reflection Paper 音樂會心得報告 (25%): 
選擇一場古典音樂會，出席欣賞，並於期末繳交一份音樂會心得報告，並附上節目單 (選擇網路上的音樂會，節目內容需至少一小時以上)。
Three-page reflection paper which summarizes your thoughts on a concert performance of your choice, which helps you to make the connection between knowledge and real-life experience. (If an online concert program is selected, the program needs to be at least an hour long)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
上課守則:
遲到早退者,累計次數超過三次,算一次曠課
上課請勿滑手機,老師提醒三次以上,將於平時成績中扣分
食物請於課前和下課時間使用
